dialog.english:
��������We made it to Karigaoka in one
piece.
dialog.translation:
Hemos llegado a Hikarigaoka de
una pieza.

dialog.english:
Good thing the bus dropped us off
here.
dialog.translation:
Menos mal que el bus nos ha
dejado aquí.

dialog.english:
Matt, T.K, that was an
amazing performance!
dialog.translation:
Matt, T.K., vaya actuación
más convincente!

dialog.english:
"It was the last place we could be
happy together before our parents
divorced..."
dialog.translation:
"Fue el último sitio donde fuimos
felices juntos antes de que
se divorciaran..."

dialog.english: Even I totally believed it!
dialog.translation: Hasta yo me lo he creído!

dialog.english:
But the camp bus wouldn't drop us
off here unless we said that.
dialog.translation:
Pero el bus no nos dejaba
aquí sin decir eso.

dialog.english:
The Karigaoka apartment complex
is huge! It's like a castle!
dialog.translation:
El bloque de Hikarigaoka es
enorme! Parece un castillo!

dialog.english:
It's not a castle. All kinds of
different people live separately
in those apartments.
dialog.translation:
No es un castillo. Viven
personas distintas por separado
en esos apartamentos.

dialog.english: Huuuuuuh?!
dialog.translation: Ehhhhhh?!

dialog.english: Humans are so interesting!
dialog.translation: Sois muy interesantes!

dialog.english:
Did you live in Karigaoka too,
Sora?
dialog.translation:
Tú también vivías en
Hikarigaoka, Sora?

dialog.english: Yeah.
dialog.translation: Sí.

dialog.english:
Sora and I were in the same class.
Third Elementary School, class
1-2!
dialog.translation:
Sora y yo íbamos a la misma
clase. Colegio Tercero, clase
1-2!

dialog.english: I went to Fourth Elementary.
dialog.translation: Yo iba al Colegio Cuarto.

dialog.english: I went to Fifth...
dialog.translation: Iba al Quinto...

dialog.english: Me too! I was in kindergarten...
dialog.translation: También! Iba a la guardería...

dialog.english:
So was I! It was only for a short
time, though...
dialog.translation:
Yo igual! Aunque fue solo
por poco tiempo...

dialog.english: Whaaaaaat?
dialog.translation: Quéeeeeé?

dialog.english: *All* of us lived in Karigaoka?
dialog.translation: TODOS vivíamos en Hikarigaoka?

dialog.english:
I don't think this is just a
coincidence.
dialog.translation:
No creo que esto sea
una coincidencia.

dialog.english:
Anyway, back to Vamdemon. He's
already made the first move.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, volviendo a Vamdemon.
Ya ha dado el primer paso.

dialog.english: Maybe not...
dialog.translation: Quizá no...

dialog.english:
What makes you think that,
Izzy?
dialog.translation:
Por qué piensas eso,
Izzy?

dialog.english:
The flow of time is different
between the two worlds. If
Vamdemon came here...
dialog.translation:
El tiempo pasa distinto entre
los dos mundos. Si Vamdemon
vino aquí...

dialog.english:
...only a minute or so should have
passed between his arrival and
ours.
dialog.translation:
...solo habrá pasado un minuto
entre su llegada y la
nuestra.

dialog.english: Oh!
dialog.translation: Oh!

dialog.english:
So if we hurry, we might beat
Vamdemon's army to the eighth
child?
dialog.translation:
Si nos damos prisa, quizá
ganemos a su ejército por
el octavo niño?

dialog.english: Okay, let's look for them!
dialog.translation: Vale, vamos a buscarlo!

dialog.english: PicoDevimon, Tailmon, take this.
dialog.translation: PicoDevimon, Tailmon, tomadlo.

dialog.english: Ah!
dialog.translation: Ah!

dialog.english: Go on! Take it!
dialog.translation: Vamos! Cogedlo!

dialog.english: Hmph! So patronizing. What's this?
dialog.translation:
Ja! Vaya prepotencia.
Qué es esto?

dialog.english:
It's a copy of the eighth child's
Crest.
dialog.translation:
Es una copia del Emblema del
octavo niño.

dialog.english: What about the real one?
dialog.translation: Y el auténtico?

dialog.english:
It's in my possession. But the
copy will still react if the
eighth child is near.
dialog.translation:
Lo tengo yo. Pero la copia
reaccionará igual si el octavo
niño está cerca.

dialog.english:
You must find the eighth child at
any cost.
dialog.translation:
Debéis encontrar al octavo niño
como sea.

dialog.english: Yes, sir!
dialog.translation: Sí señor!

dialog.english: Yes, sir!
dialog.translation: Sí señor!

dialog.english:
You might not remember it well,
T.K, but we used to play a lot
around here.
dialog.translation:
Puede que no lo recuerdes bien,
T.K., pero jugábamos mucho
por aquí.

dialog.english:
But it still feels pretty
nostalgic.
dialog.translation:
Pero aun así da bastante
nostalgia.

dialog.english:
How long did you live here,
Izzy?
dialog.translation:
Cuánto tiempo viviste aquí,
Izzy?

dialog.english: I believe it wasn't even a year.
dialog.translation: Creo que no llegó ni a un año.

dialog.english:
Must have been because of that
terrorist bombing.
dialog.translation:
Debió de ser por aquel
atentado terrorista.

dialog.english: Bombing?
dialog.translation: Bomba?

dialog.english: Terrorists?
dialog.translation: Terrorista?

dialog.english:
You guys might not remember this,
but there was a terrorist attack
here four years ago.
dialog.translation:
Puede que no os acordéis, pero
aquí hubo un atentado
terrorista hace cuatro años.

dialog.english:
They never caught the culprit, so
my parents moved away. They
thought it was too dangerous here.
dialog.translation:
Nunca cogieron al culpable, y
mis padres se mudaron. Creían
que esto era peligroso.

dialog.english:
Right, it was the same for my
family. They said something about
a bombing.
dialog.translation:
Es verdad, a mi familia le pasó
igual. Dijeron algo de un
atentado.

dialog.english:
Come to think of it, I feel like
something similar happened with my
folks.
dialog.translation:
Ahora que lo pienso, creo que a
mis padres les pasó algo
parecido.

dialog.english: Huh?
dialog.translation: Eh?

dialog.english:
Ah! Is that one of Vamdemon's
Digimon?
dialog.translation:
Ah! Es ese un Digimon de
Vamdemon?

dialog.english: That's Mammon!
dialog.translation: Es Mammon!

dialog.english: This is bad! We have to stop him!
dialog.translation: Esto es malo! Hay que pararlo!

dialog.english: Ahahaha! We did it!
dialog.translation: Jaja! Lo logramos!

dialog.english:
People can actually see Vamdemon's
Digimon...
dialog.translation:
La gente ve los Digimon
de Vamdemon...

dialog.english: Giant monsters...
dialog.translation: Monstruos enormes

dialog.english: What'd you say, T.K?
dialog.translation: Qué has dicho, T.K.?

dialog.english:
I remember! Back when we lived 
here, T.K got scolded for 
saying he saw giant monsters!
dialog.translation:
Ya me acuerdo! Cuando vivíamos
aquí, regañaron a T.K. por
decir que vio monstruos!

dialog.english: Could that have been...
dialog.translation: Podría haber sido...

dialog.english: ...the so-called bombings!
dialog.translation: ...los supuestos atentados

dialog.english:
This is definitely where the
terrorist bombings took place!
dialog.translation:
Aquí es donde pasaron los
atentados terroristas seguro!

dialog.english: It felt exactly like this!
dialog.translation: Se sintió exactamente así!

dialog.english:
Yeah. They were fighting, then
this and that happened...
dialog.translation:
Sí. Estaban luchando, y pasó
esto y aquello...

dialog.english:
(What I saw that day...wasn't a
giant monster.)
dialog.translation:
(Lo que vi ese día no era
un monstruo gigante.)

dialog.english: Koromon... Koromon, what happened?
dialog.translation:
Koromon... Koromon,
qué ha pasado?

dialog.english: W-whoa...
dialog.translation: V-vaya...

dialog.english: *sob* Koromon... Koromoooooooon!
dialog.translation: (solloza) Koromon... Koromoooon!

dialog.english: Koromon...
dialog.translation: Koromon...

dialog.english: Kari, gimme your whistle!
dialog.translation: Kari, dame tu silbato!

dialog.english: Tai?
dialog.translation: Tai?

dialog.english: Get him!
dialog.translation: Cógelo!

dialog.english:
Greymon! That's right, it was
Greymon!
dialog.translation:
Greymon! Es verdad, era
Greymon!

dialog.english: You're right...
dialog.translation: Tienes razón...

dialog.english:
That day, a Koromon came to our
home, and that Koromon became an
Agumon.
dialog.translation:
Ese día, un Koromon vino a
nuestra casa, y se convirtió
en Agumon.

dialog.english:
And then it became a Greymon, and
fought with another Digimon.
dialog.translation:
Y luego se convirtió en Greymon,
y luchó contra otro Digimon.

dialog.english:
After the fight, they both
disappeared...
dialog.translation:
Tras la pelea, los dos
desaparecieron...

dialog.english: So it wasn't a terrorist attack!
dialog.translation: Así que no fue un atentado!

dialog.english:
So you met Tai back then,
Koromon?
dialog.translation:
Así que conociste a Tai,
Koromon?

dialog.english:
It must have been a different
Koromon!
dialog.translation:
Debió de ser otro Koromon
distinto!

dialog.english:
But when I first met Tai, I had
this really nostalgic feeling...
dialog.translation:
Pero cuando conocí a Tai, sentí
algo muy nostálgico...

dialog.english:
This is bad! We're gonna get
caught, and they're gonna ask a
lot of questions!
dialog.translation:
Esto es malo! Nos van a pillar
y nos harán un montón de
preguntas!

dialog.english: R-ruuuuuun!
dialog.translation: C-corred!

dialog.english:
*pant* *pant* I think we're far
enough.
dialog.translation:
(jadeos) Ya estamos
bastante lejos.

dialog.english: Yeah.
dialog.translation: Sí.

dialog.english: I always thought it was strange.
dialog.translation: Siempre pensé que era raro.

dialog.english:
Out of all the children who went
to camp, why were we the only ones
chosen?
dialog.translation:
De todos los niños del
campamento, por qué fuimos los
únicos elegidos?

dialog.english:
But today, we've found the key to
this mystery.
dialog.translation:
Pero hoy hallamos la clave
de este misterio.

dialog.english:
The incident from four years
ago...
dialog.translation:
El incidente de hace
cuatro años...

dialog.english:
Yes. What we have in common is
that we all met the Digimon four
years ago.
dialog.translation:
Sí. Tenemos en común que todos
conocimos a los Digimon hace
cuatro años.

dialog.english: So the eighth child did, too?
dialog.translation: El octavo niño también?

dialog.english:
I'm sure they must have seen the
incident.
dialog.translation:
Seguro que también vio
el incidente.

dialog.english:
So does that mean Vamdemon's
already found them? They're in
Karigaoka, right?
dialog.translation:
Entonces eso significa que
Vamdemon ya lo ha encontrado?
Está en Hikarigaoka, no?

dialog.english:
Since Mammon was wandering around
here all alone...
dialog.translation:
Si Mammon andaba dando vueltas
por aquí solo...

dialog.english:
...the others are all prolly
wand'rin' around lookin' for the
eighth child!
dialog.translation:
...los demás deben de andar
por ahí buscando al
octavo niño!

dialog.english:
We'll find them! We'll find the
eighth child before they do!
dialog.translation:
Encontraremos al octavo niño
antes que ellos!

dialog.english: But where do we look?
dialog.translation: Pero dónde buscamos?

dialog.english:
There's one other thing we have in
common...
dialog.translation:
Hay otra cosa que tenemos
en común...

dialog.english: We all moved from Karigaoka...
dialog.translation:
Todos nos mudamos de
Hikarigaoka.

dialog.english:
Yes. It can't be a coincidence, so
we should assume that the eighth 
child has also moved.
dialog.translation:
Sí. No puede ser casualidad, así
que el octavo niño también
debió de mudarse.

dialog.english: So the eighth child is in Odaiba?
dialog.translation:
El octavo niño está en
Odaiba?

dialog.english: I wanna go hooooooome!
dialog.translation: Quiero irme a casaaa!

dialog.english:
All right! In that case, let's
head back to Odaiba!
dialog.translation:
Vale! En ese caso, volvamos
a Odaiba!

dialog.english:
Why is there an elephant in
Karigaoka?
dialog.translation:
Por qué hay un elefante en
Hikarigaoka?

dialog.english:
They must be making a movie, or
something!
dialog.translation:
Deben de estar rodando
una película!

dialog.english: Aaaaaaaaaaah!
dialog.translation: Aaaaaaaaaaah!

dialog.english: Gyaaaaaaah!
dialog.translation: Gyaaaaaaah!

dialog.english:
Tai! We have to do something
about Mammon, right now!
dialog.translation:
Tai! Hay que hacer algo con
Mammon, ahora mismo!

dialog.english: You're right, let's go!
dialog.translation: Tienes razón, vamos!

dialog.english: Let's go!
dialog.translation: Vamos!

dialog.english: Yeah!
dialog.translation: Sí!

dialog.english: Roooooooooar!
dialog.translation: Rooooooooar!

dialog.english: All right, Koromon! Evolve!
dialog.translation: Vale, Koromon! Evoluciona!

dialog.english: Got it!
dialog.translation: Vale!

dialog.english: Koromon, evolve!
dialog.translation: Ya, evoluciona!

dialog.english: Agumon!
dialog.translation: Agumon!

dialog.english: Over here!
dialog.translation: Por aquí!

dialog.english:
I'm pretty sure I just saw a
monster!
dialog.translation:
Seguro que he visto un
monstruo!
